body:
Asked by Plan (Moves needs them): the game's Pet Shop sells a frisbee and a toy mouse but they had no 3D model.
Frisbee: a soft disc with a rim, white rings and a paw, 4 colours (about 25 cm).
Toy mouse: a small grey mouse with pink ears and a long tail, 3 colours (about 30 cm with the tail).
Decide in Model Compare → Toys (🔔).
title: Toys: frisbee (monkey) and toy mouse (snake)
